title: Agriculture, Tourism & Transport
tagline: AgriTech, trekking permits, ride-hailing, and aviation
description: Nepali AgriTech is led by SmartKrishi and GeoKrishi — both internationally recognized. Tourism digital infrastructure (e-TIMS) was launched in 2023. Ride-hailing is dominated by Pathao and inDrive; Tootle pivoted in 2024.
